recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-15803; do not restore label/code wording when comparing to the original issue because FHIR-48326 validly superseded that part of the older invariant.
issue_request: FHIR-15803 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for FHIR-core StructureDefinition asking to correct the sdf-9 human wording from the ungrammatical phrase 'on the an element'.
initial_application: Jira comments record application in svn revision 13522. The current Git history has no FHIR-15803-tagged commit, but checked-in release history shows STU3 with the typo and R4-era history with the corrected 'on an element' wording.
additional_context: StructureDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml is authoritative current build input. Later Applied issue FHIR-48326 intentionally narrowed sdf-9 from label/code/requirements to requirements only, and that related issue is already represented on the combined branch by b77eec34403a5bca4ac9f69b7ea8ca3e11286785.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current sdf-9 human text reads 'no requirements on an element without a ... in the path', and an active-source scan found no remaining instance of the reported 'on the an element' wording.
